summary: A single clickable icon button that lives inside a toolbar.
description: A XUL toolbar button widget supporting icon, label, badge, and menu display modes. Inherits click/keyboard activation and checked/radio/menu semantics from the shared button base class.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Text label rendered in .toolbarbutton-text; re-rendered on change via attributeChangedCallback.

attributes.name: wrap
attributes.description: If "true", label text wraps onto multiple lines instead of using a single-line value attribute.

attributes.name: image
attributes.description: Inherited as src on .toolbarbutton-icon; the icon image URL.

attributes.name: consumeanchor
attributes.description: Inherited attribute forwarded to .toolbarbutton-icon; used for anchoring popups to the button.

attributes.name: badged
attributes.description: When "true", renders the badged fragment (icon + badge stack) instead of the plain icon/label fragment.

attributes.name: badge
attributes.description: Inherited as text content of .toolbarbutton-badge; the badge label text.

attributes.name: badgeStyle
attributes.description: Inherited as the style attribute of .toolbarbutton-badge for custom badge styling.

attributes.name: accesskey
attributes.description: Inherited attribute forwarded to .toolbarbutton-text; keyboard access key.

attributes.name: crop
attributes.description: Inherited attribute forwarded to .toolbarbutton-text controlling label text cropping (default "end").

attributes.name: dragover-top
attributes.description: Inherited attribute forwarded to .toolbarbutton-text, used for drag-and-drop visual state.

attributes.name: move-after-stack
attributes.description: On a child element, when "true" the child is appended after the badge stack rather than inserted before the icon (badged mode only).

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the button and blocks click/keypress activation.

attributes.name: group
attributes.description: Groups radio-type buttons so only one in the group is checked.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Reflects/controls whether the button's menu is open.

attributes.name: hasbeenopened
attributes.description: Set on the parent panel by the popupshowing listener; triggers deferred render() of buttons inside popups.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Child elements (menupopup, panel, tooltip, template, observes, or a plain box) are kept in place; other children are moved into the icon/label or badge-stack fragment on render.

cssProperties.name: --toolbarbutton-badge-background-color
cssProperties.description: Background color of the badge stack.

cssProperties.name: --toolbarbutton-badge-font-size
cssProperties.description: Font size of the badge text (overridden to 9px on macOS).
